description.value: A two-storey Travelodge franchise property situated on Sumas Way in Abbotsford, part of the Wyndham Hotels & Resorts family. It sits near the Trans-Canada corridor, making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley. As a national chain property, it offers the consistency and predictability of branded budget accommodation.
